brief:
Adel Darsieh and thousands of others were forced from the Tulkarem refugee camp in the West Bank by Israeli forces last year. Though Darsieh initially maintained hope of returning home, that prospect has dimmed considerably, according to Al-Monitor.

The displacement reflects broader challenges facing Palestinians in the occupied territory as political transitions loom in Israel. Displaced Palestinians now express little confidence in a post-Netanyahu era bringing change to their circumstances.
dek: After Israeli forces pushed him and thousands of others out of the West Bank refugee camp of Tulkarem last year, Adel Darsieh held onto his hope of returning home, but it is fading fast.
title: West Bank refugees lose hope of return after displacement
